definitions.explanation: The very early hours of the morning, typically from dawn until around 7 or 8 AM. More formal and specific than {朝|あさ}.

examples.japanese: {早朝|そうちょう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: I started work from early morning.

examples.japanese: {早朝|そうちょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ジョギング→ジョギング：04738_jogingu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：01385_kimochi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: Jogging in the early morning feels good.

examples.japanese: {早朝|そうちょう}⟦{便|びん}→便：noentry⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}→出発：02085_shuppatsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I'll depart on the early morning flight.

examples.japanese: {早朝|そうちょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{静|しず}かで→静か：00755_shizuka⟧⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きれいだ→きれい：00717_kirei⟧。
examples.english: The park in the early morning is quiet and the air is clean.

examples.japanese: {早朝|そうちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{目|め}が{覚|さ}めてしまい→目が覚める：23498_megasameru⟧、⟦{二度|にど}と→二度と：06482_nidoto⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}れなかった→眠る：01181_nemuru⟧。
examples.english: I woke up in the early morning and couldn't fall back asleep.

notes:
REGISTER: More formal/written than ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧.

TIME OF DAY EXPRESSIONS:
- {早朝|そうちょう} (early morning, ~5-8 AM)
- ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧ (morning)
- ⟦{午前|ごぜん}→午前：00548_gozen⟧ (AM, before noon)
- ⟦{昼|ひる}→昼：00540_hiru⟧ (noon, daytime)
- ⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧ (PM, afternoon)
- ⟦{夕方|ゆうがた}→夕方：01010_yuugata⟧ (evening)
- ⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧ (night)
- ⟦{深夜|しんや}→深夜：00368_shinya⟧ (late night)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {早朝|そうちょう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ (from early morning)
- {早朝|そうちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (in the early morning)
- {早朝|そうちょう}⟦{便|びん}→便：noentry⟧ (early morning flight)
